function make(): symbol {return Symbol('made');}
const key = make();
const alias = Symbol;
const aliased = alias('alias');
const parenthesized = (Symbol)('parenthesized');
const fromKey: typeof key = Symbol('other');
const item: {[key]: number} = {[key]: 3};
const empty: typeof item = {};
interface Named {[aliased]: string;}
const named: Named = {[aliased]: 'alias'};
const wrapped: {[parenthesized]: boolean} = {[parenthesized]: true};
const methods: {[key](value: number): string} = {[key](value) {return value.toFixed(1);}};
class Keys {static readonly key = make();}
class Holder {[Keys.key] = 4;}
const text: string = 'text';
const count: number = 0;
interface TextIndex {[text]: number;}
interface NumberIndex {[count]: string;}
const byText: TextIndex = {[text]: 5};
const byNumber: NumberIndex = {[count]: 'number'};
console.log(typeof fromKey, item[key], empty[key], named[aliased], wrapped[parenthesized], methods[key](6), new Holder()[Keys.key], byText[text], byNumber[count]);
interface Both {[key]: string; [aliased]: number;}
const both: Both = {[key]: 'one', [aliased]: 2};
class Accessor {
  get [key]() {return 7;}
  set [key](value: number) {}
}
const accessor = new Accessor();
accessor[key] = 8;
console.log(both[key], both[aliased], accessor[key]);
